name: Rocky Mountain National Park
about: Typically closed by snow from mid-October to Memorial Day; the elk rut in Sep–Oct is the park's signature wildlife event.
overview: Trail Ridge Road, the highest continuous paved highway in the US, threading through alpine tundra above 12,000 feet.
costOverview: Prices stay close to typical national-park levels — Estes Park's gateway-town restaurants charge a modest premium, and a guided alpine hike is the main splurge beyond the standard park fees.

costItems.label: Guided alpine hike or via ferrata

scenic.label: Alpine wildflowers and clearest high-country views

specialSeasons.text: This is elk rutting season — bulls bugling and sparring for mates is one of the park's most dramatic wildlife spectacles.
Trail Ridge Road is typically closed by snow through this whole window, usually reopening around Memorial Day.
